target_customer: Home health agencies and the nurses and therapists they employ
problem: Home health clinicians spend roughly 90 minutes per visit on documentation, which causes burnout, billing delays and thin charts.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to home health agencies
product_category: Ambient AI scribe, quality assurance and coding for home health

founders.name: Tiantian Zha
prior_employers: Verily (Google Life Sciences, first PM on the Debug mosquito project)
founders.background_notes: Product manager background per the YC profile page and her Elpha AMA post.

founders.name: Max Akhterov
prior_employers: Apple (staff engineer on the health team, Apple Watch health algorithms)

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech to structured chart output into many home health EHRs, including OASIS assessments, is standard LLM and integration engineering with compliance accuracy as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Copyable by other scribe vendors; some stickiness from EHR integrations and agency workflows, but the model layer is commodity.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: WellSky announced its own ambient listening for home health in October 2025, and several startups (Enzo Health, Arya Health) raised Series A rounds in the same space in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Home health nursing shortages and burnout, heavy OASIS documentation burden and billing delays; the company cites a home health market growing to 251 billion dollars by 2031 (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses with-andy.com rather than an exact andy.com match.

identity.logo: Simple wordmark file named andy-logo on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and clinician-focused, about getting evenings back

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly human name but generic, shares its name with many chatbots and the Android mascot; no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Andy AI is active and selling to named home health agencies, with founders from Google health and Apple health. No verified round, acquisition or shutdown was found, so its trajectory cannot be judged. The wedge is real but crowded as the EHR vendor WellSky and funded startups entered ambient scribing from 2025.
notes: Aggregators disagree on funding: Signalbase says 500K seed (undated), CB Insights lists a convertible note, Crunchbase style listings say pre-seed on 2024-02-27, Latka says bootstrapped. All unverified and no primary source, so no round is recorded. No dated home health scribe competitor near early 2024 was found, so the competitor list is empty.
